title: Concept: mix.lock records a weak hash algorithm
description: mix.lock declares a lockfile hash that is not SHA-256, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Mix compares whatever digest the file records, so a weaker algorithm lowers the cost of finding a second package with the same hash.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through mix.lock (hex).
risk: Mix compares whatever digest the file records, so a weaker algorithm lowers the cost of finding a second package with the same hash.
